releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v8.12.8 - Idle Thermal Overhaul & Active Cooling Fix:
- Eliminated HP BIOS/EC Quiet mode 0 RPM heat-soak bug where fans were halted until 70°C+.
- Engages proactive gentle whisper cooling (~1600-2000 RPM) at idle to maintain cool 38-45°C baseline.
- Clamps CPU to sub-1.0V base clock with EPP 80 during idle/desktop use.
- Fully unhooks background shell and electron apps from NVIDIA RTX 4060 dGPU.
